strategies.name: Repeated institutional half-hour flow
strategies.rule: For each instrument and half-hour, follow the same stable institution's net order-submission direction when it repeats on at least two of the previous three sessions; enter at the next session's first executable quote in that half-hour and exit at its end.
strategies.blocker: no NSE full order/trade files landed; additionally the published NSE schema has client-category fields but no stable institution/trader identifier

strategies.name: Algorithm-side timing proxy
strategies.rule: For trailing 1- and 5-minute windows, compute algorithm-tagged buyer notional minus algorithm-tagged seller notional divided by total notional; trade the sign above 0.20 at the next quote and exit after the matching 1- or 5-minute horizon.
strategies.blocker: no NSE full CM order/trade event files or replayable book snapshots are landed

strategies.name: Aggressor-signed order-flow imbalance
strategies.rule: Over the trailing five minutes, compute signed aggressor volume divided by total volume; trade in its direction when absolute imbalance is at least 0.20, enter at the next quote, and exit one minute later.
strategies.blocker: no NSE full CM order/trade event files or replayable book snapshots are landed

strategies.name: Five-level limit-book pressure
strategies.rule: Compute top-five-level size imbalance with level weights 1/k; trade when its absolute value is at least 0.20, cross the next observed best quote, and exit one minute later.
strategies.blocker: no NSE full CM order/trade event files or replayable book snapshots are landed

strategies.name: Single-stock futures lead cash
strategies.rule: When the front contract's completed one-minute return is at least 5 bp in absolute value and its strictly prior 60-session one-minute lead correlation with the cash share is positive, enter cash at the next minute open and exit five minutes later; use date-valid contract-to-underlying IDs and do not stitch expiries.
strategies.blocker: cash minute bars exist in the archive, but no dated single-stock futures minute bars or date-valid contract-to-underlying map are landed

note: No performance result is reported without the required licensed event or futures data. The signals are fixed; do not replace missing signed flow or book depth with OHLCV.
